title: Consolidate Protocol Types Into Framework Core
description: framework/core/js/index.ts must become the single source of truth for "protocol" types that mirror the Rust framework/core/rs/lib.rs manifest/UI-tree shape and cross the plugin/wasm boundary. framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx currently re-declares many of these (WindowLayout family, NamedLayout, ActionDescriptor, the Ui-prefixed node family, PluginManifest, ToolNode/ToolLeaf/ToolCategory, UiInspectorFieldGroup, FRAMEWORK_PANEL_TAB_* constants, UI_INSPECTOR_MIXED_PLACEHOLDER, AppDefinition-ish types, WindowEngagement family, WindowMeasure, UiSelectItem, UiKeyValueEntry, UiTreeItemAction) even though os-shell.tsx already imports WindowLayout/NamedLayout types from "@semio-tech/framework-core" — a real duplicate-declaration conflict. Fix: delete the os-shell.tsx local re-declarations of WindowLayout/NamedLayout/WindowLayoutWindowNode/StackNode/AxisNode entirely and keep only the existing import. Move every other protocol-only type/const from os-shell.tsx into core/js/index.ts (fold any Ui-node member types os-shell has that core's UiNode union lacks into core's union so core becomes the complete superset). Keep renderer-private view-model types (ActiveSession, LoadedPluginState, etc.) in os-shell, merged into a single renderer-private types region. Also add two new exported types to core/js/index.ts: ComponentKind (union of the actual componentKind string literals used across the 11 host files in framework/renderer/react/components, found by grep, not guessed) and ComponentSceneHostProps = { readonly node: UiComponentSceneNode; readonly onAction: (action: ActionDescriptor) => void } (using whatever the actual scene-node/action type names in core/js/index.ts turn out to be). Do not run git commands or build/test commands. Do not touch unrelated lines other concurrent sessions are editing in os-shell.tsx or the Rust files.
summary:
Consolidated protocol types (Rust framework/core manifest/UI-tree shapes crossing the plugin/wasm boundary) into framework/core/js/index.ts as the single source of truth, and stopped framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx from re-declaring them.

core/js/index.ts: widened existing shared node types with the extra optional fields os-shell's copies had (UiTextNode.dataAttributes, UiButtonNode.style/disabled, UiInputNode widened inputKind/commit to string + min/max/step/accept, UiSliderNode.unit, UiIconSelectNode.classifierKind widened to string, UiFieldNode widened child to UiNode + description/required/error, UiTreeNode.dropAction, UiTreeItemNode gained iconId/actions/hoverAction/unhoverAction alongside its existing icon field, ToolNode gained the button/toggle variants, PluginViewState gained locale/terminology), named the previously-anonymous stack/separator UiNode union members (new UiStackNode/UiSeparatorNode types), and added a new region ComponentSceneProtocol (StyleSpec, UiSelectItem, UiKeyValueEntry, UiTreeItemAction, UiImageNode, the 13 componentScene sub-scene types, UiExternalSlotNode, UiComponentSceneNode, ComponentKind, ComponentSceneHostProps, nodeGraphActions/textEditorActions) plus a new AppManifestProtocol sub-region inside PluginRuntime (WindowMeasure, the WindowEngagement* family, AppPanelTabDefinition, AppDefinition, PluginHotSwapEvent).

os-shell.tsx: deleted its local WindowLayout/WindowLayoutWindowNode/StackNode/AxisNode/NamedLayout re-declarations (real duplicate-identifier bug — already imported from framework-core), its local Expertise enum (same bug — already imported from @semio-tech/ui-react), ActionDescriptor, StyleSpec, the whole Ui*Node family, ToolCategory/ToolLeaf/ToolNode, UiInspectorFieldGroup, all componentScene sub-scene types, UiExternalSlotNode/UiComponentSceneNode, the WindowEngagement* family, WindowMeasure, AppPanelTabDefinition, AppDefinition, PluginHotSwapEvent, and the FRAMEWORK_PANEL_TAB_* constants, replacing them with imports from @semio-tech/framework-core (kept UI_INSPECTOR_MIXED_PLACEHOLDER local since it's a documented locale-aware renderer override of core's static default). Added explicit re-exports for the subset (ActionDescriptor, UiNode, ToolNode, UiControlNode, UiTreeItemNode/Node/SectionNode, UiComponentSceneNode, Puzzle2dBoardScene, GisMapScene, RasterScene, TextEditorScene, NodeGraphScene, PresencePeer, nodeGraphActions, textEditorActions) that ui-interpreter.tsx and the 11 components/*-host.tsx files import directly from os-shell.tsx by path. Converted the local ViewState to `export type ViewState = PluginViewState;`. Merged the early "ShellTypes" region into the adjacent "ShellHelpers" region (relocating its view-model type declarations down into the single remaining "🔖types" region, which now holds only renderer-private types), leaving PluginManifest local with a docstring explaining why it wasn't folded into core's looser wire-shape version.

Left for human review (real shape conflicts, not blindly merged): framework/core's PluginManifest.apps stays Record<string, unknown>[] (vs os-shell's richer AppDefinition[]) to avoid breaking compose/coda, which import PluginManifest from framework-core with that loose shape; UiTreeItemNode keeps both icon? (compose/coda's field name) and the new iconId? (renderer convention) rather than renaming, since compose constructs literals with icon:.

Note: an earlier ticket_close call without an explicit path mistakenly closed a concurrent session's unrelated ticket (SOURCING-APP-WITH-CURATE-DOCUMENT-AND-BEAMS-WINDOWS-SLABS-MODULES) because it was the most-recently-opened ticket at that moment; it was immediately reopened via ticket_reopen to undo the mistake.
